$comment: Leagues (docs/leagues.md), used by plugins/modes/LeagueMode.plugin.js and LeaguePoints.plugin.js. A league character is the account's separate save a league world logs it into (persistence/PlayerProfile); world.json pluginConfig `league:type` names the league, and `default` only stands in for a type this data does not know. `ironmanMode` is the Ironman mode every league character plays as (the Wiki's 'Player restrictions'). Varbits, varps, scripts and texts are from rsprox Leagues V recordings (osrs-captures 227/00070, 227/00075, 227/00579); the leagues' own numbers (XP rates, starting levels; the relic tiers are league-relics.json) are the Wiki's (Trailblazer_Reloaded_League, Raging_Echoes_League and their /Relics pages). `struct` is the cache's league struct (enum 2670 by league type) whose params the client reads; `colour` is its param 2050 as an RGB int; `unlockSpotanim` is param 1021 and `name` param 858. `passives` are the relic tiers' passive effects (the Relics pages' Tier N bullets), each from the 1-based tier named by `fromTier` (a map picks the highest tier reached): `dropRate` multiplies the boosted drops (league-boosted-drops.json), `runEnergy` stops running from draining energy, `scrollBoxes` drops clue scrolls as scroll boxes without a limit, `minigamePoints` multiplies points asked over `minigame:points`, `slayer` gives Bigger and Badder, superiors 1 in `superiorChance`, task points x `pointsMultiplier` after `freeTasks` tasks, and `combatXp` multiplies the listed skills' XP (Raging Echoes only). Applied by league/Passives.LeagueMode.js and league/BoostedDrops.LeagueMode.js.

varbits._runeday: current_runeday, days since 27 February 2002 (the client's date varbit; live sends it with the journal tabs, the Info panel's script reads it). Sent at a league login.

varps._leagueStart: tracking_playtime_leagues: minutes since the epoch of the league's start (27 November 2024 in every Leagues V capture, the same for every player). Sent when world.json's pluginConfig `league:start` (an ISO date) is set.

mapFlags._comment: The world flags the client caches in varp map_flags_cached (3717; the Wilderness plugin sends it and asks `world:map-flags` for extra bits). Script 206, the client's 'is a league account' check behind the journal's Leagues tab, the summary and the trophies, wants bit 30 set and bit 29 clear: every Leagues V login (227/00070 ...) carried flags 1073741825 (bits 30 and 0).

journal._comment: The side journal's Leagues tab (side_journal 629:34) mounts the league side panel (656) in the journal's content container (629:43), as the other tabs do on this client; live mounted it in its own tab slot. Script 3226 fills the panel's points bar (656:23) after every award, as captured.

content._comment: The structs, enums and DB rows a league needs that the cache does not carry are sent together as one structOverrides / enumOverrides / dbRowOverrides payload (GamemodeContentStore replaces the whole set on each payload). Virtual struct and enum ids start at virtualIdBase + league type x 1000; each unit keeps its own offsets (relics 0-199, ranks 900-901). The tasks' DB rows have their own ids (league-task-list.json virtualRowBase) and replace the cache's task enums 5950 and 2671.

panels._comment: The side panel's Summary / Info / Rank buttons (656:7, 656:2, 656:10), as captured (227/00075 sub 88831, 227/01845, 227/00579): each opens its interface as the main modal with if_setevents OP1 on its menu frame; the Summary also plays sound 2266 and runs script 7741 on its stats row 2 (Time Played) with '(Click to reveal)' until the row (529:23 slot 2) is clicked, then with the time played in the captured shape ('17 days, 2 hours', '19 hours, 46 minutes', '17 days, 58 minutes'). Every other row the panels draw comes from varps and the league struct.

statistics._comment: The League Summary's rows (script 7719) read these varps; the server counts what its hooks see (Statistics.LeagueMode.js) and sends each at login and when it changes. Rows the server cannot count yet stay 0: echoBossesKilled (no echo bosses), coinsGained / coinsLost, cluesCompleted (no completion event), specialAttacks (the special flag is cleared before the hit resolves), highestValueWorn.
statistics._bossParam: The NPC param the cache sets on bosses (plugins/npcs/NpcDrops.plugin.js uses the same).
